title: 皐月賞の後に・二代の決着

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, Mejiro Bright isn't able to win the Satsuki Sho. I can clearly see the pain on her face as she realizes she couldn't avenge Mejiro Ryan's loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While touched to learn the reason Bright tried so hard, Mejiro Ryan voices her preference that Mejiro Bright run for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ryan explains that when she lost the race herself, it was due in part to the weight of the Mejiro family's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright smiles at the thought of running for her own sake. With that, we set our sights on the Japanese Derby.
